Introducing Saved Views, available today for every project management workspace. Saved Views let you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild a custom setup from scratch. Whether you track overdue tasks, monitor a specific sprint, or follow a client's workload, you can lock that configuration in place and return to it with a single click.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no additional cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving individuals and teams plenty of room to organize views around projects, clients, priorities, or personal workflows. Views aren't limited to your own workspace, either: any saved view can be shared with your team, making it easy to align everyone around the same filtered perspective during standups, planning sessions, or reviews.

We built this feature after hearing repeated requests for a faster way to switch between different ways of looking at the same data. Give it a try and let us know what you think.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
